/ One DSL constructor per line: name|result rows|source. {n} becomes the
/ constructor's position in the generated desc. test_dsl_combinations.q puts
/ every ordered pair in one desc and requires each file to load and pass.
should|1|should["s{n}"]{ 1 musteq 1 };
it|1|it["i{n}"]{ 1 musteq 1 };
holdsDictVars|1|holds["h{n}";`runs`vars!(3;`a`b!(`long;`long))]{[x] (x[`a]+x[`b]) musteq x[`b]+x[`a] };
holdsRuns|1|holds["r{n}";((),`runs)!(),3]{ 1 musteq 1 };
holdsIntMaxFailRate|1|holds["m{n}";`runs`maxFailRate!(3;0)]{ 1 musteq 1 };
holdsListVars|1|holds["v{n}";`runs`vars!(3;1 2 3)]{[x] x mustin 1 2 3 };
holdsFunctionVars|1|holds["f{n}";`runs`vars!(3;{til 3})]{[x] x mustmatch til 3 };
perf|1|perf["p{n}";`maxTime`runs!(10000;2)]{ til 10 };
skip|1|skip["skip{n}"]{ 1 musteq 1 };
pending|1|pending["pending{n}"];
skipIf|1|skipIf[0b;"skipIf{n}"]{ 1 musteq 1 };
retry|1|retry[2;"retry{n}"]{ 1 musteq 1 };
shouldEach|2|shouldEach["each{n}";([]a:1 2)]{[a] a musteq a };
alt|1|alt{ before{ `altRan mock 1b }; should["alt{n}"]{ must[altRan;"alt before ran"] } };
